_about: Codeplug object field layouts for open-astro cpg_decode. Offsets are byte offsets inside one record; 'be' = big-endian. 'confidence': verified = ground-truthed byte-exact against backups/*.cpg; partial = structurally identified, semantics not fully proven; unknown = position fixed but meaning unresolved. Source: empirical diff of 93 real 0x0FFB personality records across 205CFR2930 (800 P25), 407CHT0214 (VHF analog) and Radio1_205CMB2249. Builders live in PatPort.exe (0x0FFD table builder 0x11f9738, 0x0FFB 0x65fffc) with register-computed geometry, so names come from ground truth, not static RE.

0x0FFB._note: Stored as count-prefixed tables under stream tag 0x0FFD (6-byte table header: 4 reserved + u16 count). Each record self-identifies with tag 0x0FFB at offset 0.

fields.name: personality_type
fields.note: observed 0x322f / 0x642a; not band (both appear on 800 MHz radio)

fields.name: nac_alt
fields.note: third NAC, mirrors nac_rx in all samples

fields.name: freq_alt
fields.note: third freq, mirrors freq_tx in all samples

fields.name: squelch_mid
fields.note: mirrors rx tone on most channels but can differ (e.g. 0c 1e 0c); squelch-mode/alt-tone, unresolved

fields.name: flags
fields.note: 0x80 = simplex/direct (rx==tx) VERIFIED; 0x40 = duplex/repeater (rx!=tx) VERIFIED (e.g. 806.5125 rx / 851.5125 tx, standard 800 MHz 45 MHz split)

0x0FFD._note: Stream payload = 4 reserved + u16 count + count * 35-byte 0x0FFB records. See 0x0FFB for the record layout.

fields.name: reserved
fields.note: NOT always reserved: on even instances these 4 bytes carry 0x0FFD followed by a u16 sub-id (odd-numbered 1,3,5,...); only odd instances are zero-filled. The count u16 at offset 4 holds in both.

fields.name: count
fields.note: record count; holds on both even and odd instances

0x0020._note: Empirically verified across 205CFR2930/407CHT0214/Radio1_205CMB2249 (all 22 B, 7 pairs). resv[4] + u16 count + u16 capacity, then count x 2-byte (control_id, function) pairs. Control ids {0x03,0x04,0x60,0x61,0x62,0x94,0x86} are identical across radios = the 7 programmable controls; function values differ per radio. Function enum not yet decoded (needs PatPort.exe builder 0x50c4fc, type 174). Distinct from button streams 0x0016/0x0017.

fields.name: pairs
fields.note: count x (u8 control_id, u8 function); function enum TBD

0x000D._note: Empirically verified across 3 radios (205CFR2930=2 zones Z1/Z2, 407CHT0214=3 A/B/C, Radio1=10 A..J,RB). resv[4] + u16 (constant 50, likely max-name-len/field size) + u16 count, then count x 17-byte records = 16-byte ASCII zone name (space/NUL padded) + 1 trailing byte (0). Names only; channel->zone linkage lives elsewhere (0x0FFC refs / 0x0FFE). Builder PatPort.exe 0x120d916 (type 172), enum/flags TBD.

fields.name: records
fields.note: count x 17 B: 16-byte ASCII name + 1 trailing byte
